title: Unbounded wide-string copy (c)
description: The code copies a wide string with wcscpy, which has no destination size parameter. A source longer than the destination overwrites whatever follows it, and each wide character is two or four bytes. This lexical rule flags the copy; the reviewer checks the destination size.
remediation: Copy with an explicit element count and terminate, or use a wide-string container, for example wcsncpy_s with the destination element count.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the copy without tracking source length.
